notes:
This update covers everything since 1.41.14.

A bot that was already open no longer gets stuck stopping and starting. Pressing Launch on an account whose window was already up started a second copy, the app closed the newer one, and Auto-Restart launched another - so the Bots list showed it stopping and starting until you closed the original by hand. Launch now links to the open bot instead, the watcher does the same for any account it finds up but listed as stopped, and it waits up to three minutes for a bot that is still logging in before it will relaunch it.
